name: Scorched Earth
description: Survives by ensuring nothing useful remains for anyone pursuing them
behavioral_signature: Everything behind them is ash, slag, or corrupted data
under_stress: Destroys things they still need in the panic to leave nothing
at_rest: Preparing demolition plans for every place they occupy
will_never: leave something intact that could be used to track them
unless: someone they care about needs what they'd destroy
